c: Most help starts in Employee Center: search, or choose a topic.
say: Most help starts in Employee Center. Search for what you need, or choose a topic.

c: The chat button opens Now Support, the Virtual Agent, for quick questions.
say: For a quick question, the chat button at the bottom right opens Now Support, the virtual agent.

c: A new email becomes an incident; a reply adds to the ticket it answers.
say: Away from the portal? A new email becomes an incident, and a reply adds to the ticket it answers.

c: When it's urgent, call +1-200-120-2020, 9am to 5pm PST.
say: When it's urgent and you can't work, call the service desk, from nine to five Pacific time.

c: Every way leads to one ticket with its number.
say: Whichever way you choose, you get one ticket, with its number.

c: You get an email at each step, and follow it in My Requests.
say: You get an email at each step, and you follow it in My Requests.
